title: Attach a file to a chat message
description: One file the person is attaching: its name as their system gives it (sanitised before it is used), its media type (`''` when the browser doesn't know it) and its bytes as base64. With `of`, a picture the page made from a file already attached: a PDF's page, or a copy of a picture that fits the limits.

name.description: The file's name; the server keeps letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_`, and never trusts the rest.

type.description: The file's media type, as the browser reports it; `''` when unknown. Any type is taken.

data.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, padded; at most 10 MB once decoded, at most 5 MB with `of`.

of.description: What this picture was made from. The server names it and saves it in a folder beside that file; `name` and `type` are not used.

path.description: The attached file's path, as this operation answered it.

page.description: The PDF's page this is a picture of (a PNG). Left out, this is a fitted copy of a picture (a PNG or a JPEG).

pages.description: How many pages the PDF has, as the sandboxed reader found.
